text:
- tad idaṃ māyādiṣaṭkaṃ kañcukaṣaṭkam ucyate — this Māyā-and-rest six is called six sheaths. [tsa-a08-v55] (R) [CLM-001]
- Māyā-six = six sheaths named. [tsa-a08-v55] (R) [CLM-002]
- saṃvido māyayā apahastitatvena kalādīnām uparipātināṃ kañcukavat avasthānāt — awareness by Māyā set aside; kalā and the rest falling above stand like sheaths. [tsa-a08-v56] (R) [CLM-003]
- Set-aside awareness; above-falling kalā stands sheath-like. [tsa-a08-v56] (R) [CLM-004]
[tantrasara-a08:tsa08-p03]
